notes: Short conference case study (2 pages + citation page) of forage introduction and evaluation for cut-and-carry irrigated dairying in the Eritrean central highlands. Planted forages fed cut-and-carry fit feed_mgmt, but the paper reports no costs or returns, no adoption figure (only 'interested farmers' took material and one demonstration farm; 'the introduction and adoption' is asserted without numbers), and no carbon income.
